data.one_liner: Dynamic bottom navigation bar with an animated ball indicator
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable bottom bar that can be driven by a PageController or an activeIndex. It supports icon rotation, custom spacing, radii, elevation, and item sizing.
use_when: You need a bottom navigation bar with a smooth animated indicator
You want to control the bar via a PageController or a simple activeIndex
You need custom spacing or icon rotation effects
You prefer a lightweight widget with no external dependencies
avoid_when: You require a full-featured navigation system with nested routes
You need advanced theming or integration with other UI kits
You are building a complex app that needs multiple navigation bars
strengths: Highly customizable appearance (spacing, radii, elevation, item size)
Simple API with no extra dependencies
Supports both PageController and activeIndex control
Built-in icon rotation and active color handling
weaknesses: No built-in support for deep linking or nested navigation
